'''Morro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonist native to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. One of the first settlers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Morro Spaceport]] was named to commemorate his deeds.<ref name="MPQ" />
